title: I see the benefits
text:
First, it was super cute. I didn’t have to go to the store for a literally anything… It included the scissors, glue, any string, paint, literally everything my son would need to do the crafts in the box.

But I was slightly annoyed to see that they were simply dollar store products. They didn’t even do the crafts themselves.

I mean… Good on ‘em. It’s brilliant as a business. I just expected more for the price I was paying.
label: neutral
